summary: khedmaPro follow-up validation. Backend 14/14 pytest passing after fixing a seed-data bug: providers were seeded with @servicepro.dz instead of @khedmapro.dz emails (server.py:581). I patched the string and migrated the 12 existing DB rows in-place, then all auth flows work with provider1..12@khedmapro.dz / password123. Also fixed a hard red-screen crash in the frontend: /app/frontend/app/provider/[id].tsx was calling useT() without importing it (ReferenceError: useT is not defined) — added the missing import from @/src/language. After both fixes, every requested flow verified in Expo web preview at mobile viewport (390x844): onboarding shows khedmaPro brand + compact language switcher + 'Browse services' primary + 'I'm a service provider' + 'Sign in' link; language switcher translates to French (Parcourir les services) and Arabic (تصفح الخدمات); Browse services opens client home WITHOUT login showing 'Find a pro' header + 'Sign in' header button + 12 provider cards + horizontal category chips; provider detail shows rating, sticky Request Booking, Write a review, and 8–9 seeded fake reviews; guest booking end-to-end succeeds (booking appears in provider dashboard 'Recent bookings'); tapping Write a review as a guest correctly shows the sign-in gate (review-gate-register-btn + review-gate-signin-btn, NO submit form); after signing in as a client the actual review form (star picker + comment-input + submit-review-btn) renders; provider1@khedmapro.dz signs in successfully and lands on the Provider Dashboard with trial banner + stats + rating + recent bookings.

rca_of_issue: Two bugs found & fixed. (1) Seed emails: server.py mixed the app rename — the idempotency check compared '@khedmapro.dz' while the insert wrote '@servicepro.dz', so the seeded providers matched the old ServicePro name and login with the credentials documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md failed. Fixed the string and migrated the 12 rows via motor. (2) Provider detail red screen: refactor to i18n added `const { t, isRTL } = useT()` on line 16 of app/provider/[id].tsx but forgot to import useT from '@/src/language'. Because the file compiled fine (TS treats undefined bindings as any at usage sites via JSX-under-emit), the failure only surfaced at runtime when the screen mounted. Added the missing import — screen now renders the sticky Request Booking, Write a review, and seeded reviews list correctly.
